name: com.clostra.newnode.internal.PermissionActivity
description: NewNode (Clostra's decentralized content delivery SDK) opens this Activity when it needs Android's nearby-device permissions. It explains location access where required and requests nearby Wi-Fi, location, or Bluetooth permission before starting nearby connections.
disableEffect: Without this Activity, NewNode cannot request the permissions needed for nearby content delivery, so app content that depends on this network may not load.
